name: add_interlinked_context
description: Bulk-add multiple memory nodes with automatic similarity linking. Computes embeddings for all items, then creates similarity edges between any pair (new-to-new and new-to-existing) with cosine similarity ≥ 0.72. Ideal for importing related concepts, files, or notes at once.

items.description: Array of nodes to add. Each needs type, label, and content.

auto_link.description: Whether to auto-create similarity edges. Default: true.
